name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow with a one-confirmation multi-AI command center, safe isolated integration, and mature-workflow deferral.

interface.shortDescription: One confirmed plan for complex multi-AI work; safe local integration.
interface.longDescription: Silently defer to a repository's mature workflow. Simple work keeps the familiar isolated lifecycle; complex work gets one plain-language plan confirmation, then a central controller schedules up to five independent workers with local-only DWW integration and evidence-led completion. Explicit publishing remains a separate dry-run-first, non-force operation after Finish.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route this modifying Git task first. Silently defer to an existing mature workflow; use one plain-language confirmed plan for a complex goal, otherwise follow the managed or local-choice route.
